arguments.name: weekly-project-summary
arguments.description: Use when the user asks for a weekly summary of the current project using its saved notes and verified task state.
arguments.instructions: Read the current user request and relevant saved project notes. Use files_list with path="." and files_read with an observed relative text path. Collect actual completed work, blockers and next steps. If an essential source is missing, use ask_user once with selectable choices; do not ask for information already in this chat. Save a Markdown artifact using artifact_save with title, type="markdown" and complete source containing Completed, Blockers and Next steps. For a revision, artifact_read first, then artifact_save with the same artifact_id and returned current expected_version unchanged. Return the actual artifact and cite source file/message IDs. Do not invent progress or contact external services.
